payload.title: Document collaborative steering on the Papyrus marketing site
payload.description:
Standing rule: each initiative gets a documentation story on the Papyrus marketing site when its features are live. Document reader accounts, submit-a-link, moderation modes, votes and ratings, karma, comments as a steering signal, and the snapshot-driven live numbers. See the existing marketing-site documentation stories PPY-ab79ea and PPY-228e8d for conventions.

```gherkin
Feature: Marketing site documentation
  Scenario: Features documented
    Given the collaborative steering features are live on a pilot site
    Then the Papyrus marketing site describes each, with setup steps and a link to the pilot
```
